title: Civic Passports
description: Adds an RP passport system with registration, citizenship, status, insurance, officer checks, and entry/exit stamps for Forge servers.
body:
# Civic Passports

Civic Passports adds a roleplay passport system for Minecraft Forge servers.

Players can register passports with RP names and ages, manage citizenship and status information, and use documents for borders, prisons, governments, cities, and other multiplayer roleplay systems.

---

## Language Support

Currently, the mod officially supports only the Russian language.

Some commands, tags, and passport fields are designed specifically for Russian-speaking roleplay servers.

English localization may be added in future updates.


---

## Features

* RP passport registration
* Passport viewing system
* Citizenship field
* Status field
* Medical insurance field
* Officer-controlled editing
* Entry and exit stamps
* State confirmation system
* Passport request / accept / deny system

---

## Officer System

Server staff or roleplay officers can receive permission using:

```mcfunction
/tag PlayerName add Государство
```

Officers can:

* confirm passports
* edit citizenship
* edit status
* edit insurance
* place entry and exit stamps

---

## Commands

```mcfunction
/passport register <rp_name> <age>
/passport see
/passport ask <player>
/passport accept
/passport deny
/passport stamp entry <player>
/passport stamp exit <player>
/passport confirm <player> <place>
/passport insurance <player> <state>
/passport citizenship <player> <name>
/passport status <player> <status>
```

---

## Requirements

* Minecraft 1.20.1
* Forge
* Java 17

---

## Planned Features

* Full passport GUI
* Border terminals
* HTML passport export
* Government databases
* Custom stamps
* Passport photos
* State integration systems
